title: Jetpack!
description: This Datapack adds a jetpack to the game! you can use "/function jetpack:jetpack" to get the jetpack and shift while wearing it to fly!
body: This Datapack adds a jetpack to the game! The jetpack has awesome particles and fun physics! Its not very fast but still pretty cool! could make a fun minigame like air duels or pig basket ball with flying and fishing rods!
